name: Infinite Horizon's raid damage aura and Unmake scaling bonus already work (#894)
contract: Infinite Horizon 560528 (Chronomancer Duality talent, CharacterAdvancement 6158) reads "Increases the all damage dealt by party and raid members by $s1%. Does not stack with similar effects. In addition, your Unmake and Timerend gain an additional $s2% bonus spell scaling." Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID with SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, MiscValue 127, EffectBasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = 3, radius 287 = 100 yd; it is a member of the CoA raid damage group 2000184 (rev_20260922_27_raid_damage_percent_group.sql), whose non-stacking is proven by stormbringer-fix-conductor-in-charge. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 24 = SPELLMOD_BONUS_MULTIPLIER, 19 + 1 = 20, masked to SpellFamily 28 word1 0x03000000 = Unmake (0x02000000) and Timerend (0x01000000). Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone multiplies an existing coefficient by that modifier. With a fixture +2000 spell damage (Drink Fel Infusion 44505), Unmake rank 11 574345's periodic coefficient (DBC 0.0624; SpellLevel 60, MaxLevel 78, so a level factor of 66/80) adds c = about 103 to the harness's 1000 base. Learning the talent must raise that query by (1000 + 1.2c) * 1.03 - (1000 + c) = about 54; the raid effect alone would give about 33, so the rise must be at least 45 (at most 110 even if the world carried a 0.12 dot row). A grouped ally's spell damage must rise by exactly 3%. The modifier also reaches Timerend rank 7 572578, but every Timerend rank has EffectBonusMultiplier 0.0 (801291's 0.1 is cleared by AscensionStockCoefficients) and its description states no spell power term, so that half has no coefficient to multiply; it is recorded in docs/coa/chronomancer-completion.md, not asserted here.
